findings.reason: The [section:thm8a14c] and [section:9v3i7vs1] tests build their own ListPage / ListWithCreate inside the test and assert that their own handlers ran (mutate/invalidate/openEntity are called by the test's own onSubmit). They prove the /ui components can be composed this way, not that the native list screens or any real create-from-list flow do. The goal names the existing native list page and create-from-list. A stronger check would render one real plugin list screen (e.g. plugins/c4s-plugin-api-contracts/src/entity/endpoint/frontend/list-page.tsx) or its create dialog.

The loading branch only checks that 'No endpoints.' is absent. It never checks that LoadingState actually renders (e.g. its skeleton lines or role/aria-busy), so the test would still pass if the body rendered nothing while loading.
